programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: The Sandlot
programme.desc: When Scotty Smalls moves to a new neighborhood, he manages to make friends with a group of kids who play baseball at the sandlot. Together they go on a series of funny and touching adventures. The boys run into trouble when Smalls borrows a ball from his stepdad that gets hit over a fence. - Thomas Guiry, Mike Vitar, Patrick Renna, Chauncey Leopardi, Marty York (Children, Comedy drama)

programme.title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
programme.desc: Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming. - Jenna Ortega, Percy Hynes White, Marisol Nichols, Adam Rodriguez, Elias Kacavas (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

programme.title: Sound of Violence
programme.desc: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain.

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to the life he has abandoned.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune.

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: Iris finds her comfortable New York City life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: A scholarship student (Brendan Fraser) hides his Jewish heritage to fit in at an Eastern prep school in the mid-1950s.

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: A sports junkie (Keanu Reeves) agrees to coach Little League Baseball in Chicago in order to pay his gambling debts.

programme.title: Road Trip
programme.desc: Josh (Breckin Meyer) videotapes his affair with another girl and accidentally mails it to his girlfriend. Discovering the mistake, he tows two of his college buddies -- and one not-so-eager kid who happens to own the car -- on a raucous 1,800-mile road trip from Ithaca, N.Y., to Austin, Texas, to save his lifelong romance. - Seann William Scott, Breckin Meyer, D.J. Qualls, Fred Ward, Andy Dick (Comedy)

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: A notorious crime boss forces two legendary car thieves to steal a vehicle to win back their freedom. Joined by two beautiful women, the team has one week to pull off the daring heist or risk losing everything, including their lives. - Scott Eastwood, Freddie Thorp, Ana de Armas, Gaia Weiss, Simon Abkarian (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: War Pony
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood. - Jojo Bapteise Whiting, LaDainian Crazy Thunder, Ashley Shelton, Robert Stover, Jesse Schmockel (Drama)

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything. - Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Scarlett Johansson, Julianne Moore, Tony Danza, Glenne Headley (Comedy drama, Romance)

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Never Say Never
programme.desc: A young singing sensation prepares to dazzle the crowd at a sold-out show at Madison Square Garden. Legions of adoring Bieber fans scream as he takes center stage for a memorable night of music. Concert footage mixes with home videos of Justin playing drums and showcasing his talent. - Boyz II Men (Documentary)

programme.title: Imagine That
programme.desc: Like many busy professionals, Evan Danielson (Eddie Murphy) is so focused on his career that quality time with his young daughter, Olivia (Yara Shahidi), has fallen by the wayside. When an important promotion is suddenly within reach, stressed-out Evan starts to fall apart while trying to fend off his company rival (Thomas Haden Church). But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems. - Eddie Murphy, Thomas Haden Church, Yara Shahidi, Nicole Ari Parker, Ronny Cox (Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama)

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: A notorious crime boss forces two legendary car thieves to steal a vehicle to win back their freedom. Joined by two beautiful women, the team has one week to pull off the daring heist or risk losing everything, including their lives. - Scott Eastwood, Freddie Thorp, Ana de Armas, Gaia Weiss, Simon Abkarian (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: Following the journey of Vanessa, a grief-stricken woman who mysteriously finds herself navigating between parallel spaces. - Aldis Hodge, Edwin Hodge, Danielle Deadwyler (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: The owner of a factory that produces flavor extracts, Joel Reynold (Jason Bateman) seems to have it all, but really doesn't. What's missing is sexual attention from his wife, Suzie (Kristen Wiig). Joel hatches a convoluted plan to get Suzie to cheat on him, thereby clearing the way for Joel to have an affair with Cindy (Mila Kunis), an employee. But what Joel doesn't know is that Cindy is a sociopathic con artist, and a freak workplace accident clears the way for her to ruin Joel forever. - Jason Bateman, Mila Kunis, Kristen Wiig, Ben Affleck, J.K. Simmons (Comedy)

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. - Noah Ringer, Dev Patel, Nicola Peltz, Jackson Rathbone, Shaun Toub (Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street. - Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson, Sinbad, Abe Vigoda, Shar Jackson (Comedy)

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home. - Jason Segel, Dakota Johnson, Casey Affleck, Isabella Kai Rice, Violet McGraw (Drama)

programme.title: Mean Creek
programme.desc: Quiet adolescent Sam (Rory Culkin) has been bullied by George (Josh Peck), a fellow student who has trouble fitting in with other teens. When Rocky (Trevor Morgan), Sam's elder brother, finds out Sam is being picked on, he enlists his buddies to help get back at George. They ask George to accompany them on a boating expedition deep in the woods, but when their plan to humiliate George horrifically backfires, the friends make a series of poor decisions that will change their lives. - Rory Culkin, Ryan Kelley, Scott Mechlowicz, Trevor Morgan, Josh Peck (Drama)

programme.title: Strange Darling
programme.desc: Nothing is what it seems when a twisted one-night stand spirals into a serial killer's vicious murder spree. - Willa Fitzgerald, Kyle Gallner, Ed Begley Jr., Barbara Hershey, Steven Michael Quezada (Thriller, Horror)

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives. - Josh Hartnett, Charithra Chandran, Marko Zaror, Katee Sackhoff, Julian Kostov (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
programme.desc: When the Mason family moves to idyllic Palos Verdes, Calif., the father, Phil, loves it but the mother, Sandy, feels out of place among the fake tans and tennis skirts. Phil and Sandy's daughter, Medina, is a loner and outcast at school, while her charismatic brother, Jim, is effortlessly popular. When Medina and Jim take up surfing, they must prove their right to share the waves with the tough Bayboys gang that monopolizes their stretch of beach. - Jennifer Garner, Maika Monroe, Cody Fern, Noah Silver, Justin Kirk (Comedy drama)

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: The Seven Five
programme.desc: Former NYPD officer Michael Dowd tells how he and his partner committed a long list of crimes, including running their own cocaine ring, while on the job in the 1980s and early '90s. (Documentary, Biography)

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents. - Rod Steiger, Jeff Saumier, Ray Aranha, Mark Camacho, Jane Wheeler (Drama)

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet. - Bowen Yang, Lily Gladstone, Kelly Marie Tran, Han Gi-chan, Bobo Le (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Chopped - Julia Child's Kitchen: Part 1
programme.desc: Competitors race to turn mystery ingredients into extraordinary three-course meals. (Christmas, Food)

programme.title: Chopped - Julia Child's Kitchen: Part 2
programme.desc: Four chefs arrive to celebrate the major impact that Julia Child made on the culinary world. (Christmas, Food)

programme.title: Chopped - Julia Child's Kitchen: Part 3
programme.desc: Four chefs embrace their inner culinary idol to honor Julia Child's legacy and impress guest judge Isabella Rossellini. (Christmas, Food)

programme.title: Chopped - Julia Child's Kitchen: Part 4
programme.desc: Four devotees of the cooking icon Julia Child endeavor to make her proud when they put a riff on her fish stew for an appetizer. Veal makes an appearance in the entrée basket, while fruit and processed cheese make for an oddball combo in dessert. (Christmas, Food)

programme.title: Chopped - Julia Child's Kitchen: Finale
programme.desc: Four champions return to compete in the finale of a special tournament celebrating Julia Child's legacy. The competitor whose meal is the best will become the grand champion and win a $25,000 dream trip to follow in Julia's footsteps in France! (Christmas, Food)

programme.title: Great British Menu - London and South East England: Starter and Fish
programme.desc: Great Britain's top chefs compete for the honor of cooking an incredible four-course banquet. (Reality TV, Food)

programme.title: Chopped - A Taste of China
programme.desc: Four chefs compete in a battle celebrating Chinese cuisine; they scramble to distinguish themselves when prompted to make similar appetizers, showcase their unique style with an impressive salmon entrée and craft a dessert from noodles and candy. (Christmas, Food)

programme.title: Chopped - As Duck Would Have It
programme.desc: Four lucky duck chefs are pumped to get a beautiful appetizer basket that includes duck as an ingredient; in the entrée round, the chefs continue to cook with confidence and creativity when faced with a basket featuring a comfort food mashup. (Christmas, Food)

programme.title: Great British Menu - London and South East England: Starter and Fish

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes - Reintroduction to Top Tonkatsu
programme.desc: People may not know that they've been eating Tonkatsu for years; Rachel reintroduces people to her version of the dish; fried pork chops, served with an umami-rich sauce. (Food)

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes - Thai Chicken With Sweet and Hot Peppers
programme.desc: It's make-your-own-take-out time; on the menu tonight is Thai chicken; made with both sweet and hot peppers, topped with basil and mint, it's sure to become a takeout favorite. (Food)

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes - Pork Chops With Twice-Cooked Potatoes
programme.desc: Rachel is cooking up pork loin chops with sweet onions and apples and serving it with twice-baked potatoes topped with sour cream and chives, all in minutes. (Food)

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes - Hella Mega Suiza Rock Mex Burgers
programme.desc: In honor of Rachael's rock star friends, she's making Hella Mexa Suiza Burgers, or hamburgers and fries cooked with Mexican spices and topped with Swiss and Mexican soft cheese. (Food)

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes - Pork Chops Pizzaiola
programme.desc: Rachael is coming in strong with this flavorful pork chop pizzaiola recipe made with blistered tomatoes, onions and garlic cooked a la plancha style. (Food)

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes - Make Your Own Pad Thai
programme.desc: Pad Thai is a crowd favorite and less intimidating than one might think to make; this recipe literally takes minutes to make, so much so that Rachael makes the recipe twice with shrimp and chicken. (Food)

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes - Impossibly Delicious Brunch
programme.desc: Rachael shows how to make a brunch menu of parm frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that can be served all day. (Food)

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes - Grown up Tomato Soup and Grilled Cheese
programme.desc: A classic childhood combo gets an adult makeover; Rachael shows her version of a creamy tomato soup and a spicy grilled cheese. (Food)

programme.title: Murder in a Small Town
programme.desc: Karl Alberg moves to the idyllic coastal town of Gibsons to become the new police chief and soothe a psyche that has been battered by big-city police work. Unfortunately, the gentle paradise has more than its share of secrets, and Karl needs to call upon all the skills that made him a world-class detective in solving the murders that, even in this seemingly idyllic setting, continue to wash up on his shore. Cassandra, a local librarian, becomes Alberg's muse, foil and romantic interest. The show is based on the Edgar Award-winning, nine-book "Karl Alberg" series by acclaimed novelist L.R. Wright. - Rossif Sutherland, Kristin Kreuk, Marcia Gay Harden, Peter Gallagher (Crime drama)

programme.title: Nation's Dumbest
programme.desc: "Nation's Dumbest" is a celebrity competition series with a twisted premise: it's the only game show where winning is the last thing anyone wants. Famous faces are sent back to "summer school" and must relive the highs and humiliations of school life through a mix of brain-teasing pop quizzes, fast-paced physical challenges, and tests built on long-buried classroom knowledge. Rather than striving for a top prize, contestants battle to stay out of last place, because the worst performer is publicly humiliated with the unwanted title of "The Nation's Dumbest." Each week, the "smartest" celebrity graduates and leaves the competition, narrowing the field until a high-stakes final exam determines who ultimately fails their way to the infamous crown. The show channels a spirit of playful self-mockery, celebrating humor, humility, and the universal experience of not always getting it right. (Game show)

programme.title: Would You Rather
programme.desc: Iris (Brittany Snow) and seven other desperate people become trapped in Shepard's (Jeffrey Combs) mansion. Shepard forces them to play a sadistic game for a large sum of money -- but the dilemmas become increasingly deadly. - Brittany Snow, Jeffrey Combs, Jonny Coyne, Lawrence Gilliard Jr., Enver Gjokaj (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Rumours
programme.desc: Leaders of the world's wealthiest democracies gather for the annual G7 summit to draft a provisional statement regarding a global crisis. They soon become spectacles of incompetence, contending with increasingly surreal obstacles as night falls in the misty woods, and they realize they are suddenly alone. - Cate Blanchett, Roy Dupuis, Denis Ménochet, Charles Dance, Nikki Amuka-Bird (Comedy, Horror)

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: A New York lawyer (Michael Douglas) with a wife (Anne Archer) and daughter sleeps with a client (Glenn Close) whose lust turns to hate.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: A woman suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick ensnares a San Francisco cop in a web of lust and deceit.

programme.title: The Violent Heart
programme.desc: Long-buried secrets threaten to tear a couple apart.

programme.title: Rumours
programme.desc: Leaders of the world's wealthiest democracies become spectacles of incompetence, contending with increasingly surreal obstacles as night falls in the misty woods, and they realize they are suddenly alone.

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: Ensconced in her sprawling San Jose, California mansion, eccentric firearm heiress Sarah Winchester believes she is haunted by the souls of people killed by the Winchester repeating rifle.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation.

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: Following the journey of Vanessa, a grief-stricken woman who mysteriously finds herself navigating between parallel spaces.

programme.title: Last Weekend
programme.desc: Petty squabbling marks the Memorial Day reunion of an affluent matriarch (Patricia Clarkson) and her dysfunctional family (Chris Mulkey, Zachary Booth).

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
programme.desc: Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming.

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

programme.title: Steel Magnolias
programme.desc: Based on the play about six Southern women who become close friends despite their eccentricities and complicated lives.

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Big Night
programme.desc: Chef Primo and businessman Secondo are immigrant brothers from Italy who open their dream restaurant, Paradise, in New Jersey. However, Primo's authentic food is too unfamiliar for the local tastes, and the restaurant is struggling. When famous Italian-American bandleader Louis Prima is scheduled to appear at Paradise, the two brothers put all of their efforts into the important meal, which will likely decide the fate of their restaurant. - Minnie Driver, Ian Holm, Isabella Rossellini, Tony Shalhoub, Stanley Tucci (Drama)

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Stephanie Zinone (Michelle Pfeiffer) is the leader of Rydell High School's Pink Ladies, a gang of girls who are counterparts of the school's group of greasers called the T-Birds. Stephanie is tired of her relationship with top T-Bird Johnny Nogerelli (Adrian Zmed), so she breaks up with him and quickly catches the eye of English exchange student Michael Carrington (Maxwell Caulfield). Hoping to win her over, Michael tries to overcome his nerdy ways while holding off the jealous Johnny. - Maxwell Caulfield, Michelle Pfeiffer, Pamela Segall, Didi Conn, Eve Arden (Musical, Romance, Comedy)

programme.title: Men, Women & Children
programme.desc: Like many Americans, average suburbanite Don Truby and his 15-year-old son use the Internet for information, communication and viewing pornography. Don's son Chris also maintains sexually explicit conversations with classmate Hannah, an aspiring actress whose mother posts pictures of her daughter on a modeling Website. In sharp contrast, overprotective mom Patricia Beltmeyer does everything in her power to protect her daughter from the digital age. - Rosemarie DeWitt, Jennifer Garner, Judy Greer, Dean Norris, Adam Sandler (Drama)

programme.title: Kindred
programme.desc: A pair of twisted, young criminals decide to break into a mansion for one big score, but they soon find out that the owners of the house are much more dangerous than they are. - Deanna Jarvis, Derick Agyemang, Kylee Evans, Jonathan Goad, Ish Morris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. - Marisa Tomei, Sherry Cola, Ciara Bravo, Marco Pigossi, José María Yazpik (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. - Alexandra Grey, David Beck, Jacob Moran, Hudson Paul, Fiona Morgan Quinn (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Hard Truths
programme.desc: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences. - Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Michele Austin, David Webber, Tuwaine Barrett, Sophia Brown (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them. - Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan, Rosario Dawson, Michael Chiklis, Anthony Mackie (Family, Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Personal Shopper
programme.desc: A young American in Paris works as a personal shopper for a celebrity. She seems to have the ability to communicate with spirits, like her recently deceased twin brother. Soon, she starts to receive ambiguous messages from an unknown source. - Kristen Stewart, Lars Eidinger, Sigrid Bouaziz, Anders Danielsen Lie, Ty Olwin (Thriller, Mystery, Drama)

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. - Scarlett Johansson, Jonathan Rhys-Meyers, Emily Mortimer, Matthew Goode, Brian Cox (Drama)

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. - Scarlett Johansson, Pilou Asbæk, "Beat" Takeshi Kitano, Michael Carmen Pitt, Juliette Binoche (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. - Angelina Jolie, Jon Voight, Iain Glen, Noah Taylor, Daniel Craig (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both. - Clint Eastwood, Hilary Swank, Morgan Freeman, Anthony Mackie, Jay Baruchel (Drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Boudica: Queen of War
programme.desc: Roman conquerors slay King Prasutagus, take away his children, and force his wife, Boudica, into subservience. Consumed by grief and a burning desire for justice, Boudica vows to reclaim her homeland from the clutches of the Romans. She soon leads her army in a desperate assault as the fate of her people and her own destiny hang in the balance. - Olga Kurylenko, Clive Standen, Peter Franzén, Lucy Martin, Nick Moran (Historical drama, War, Action)

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. - Angelina Jolie, Gerard Butler, Ciarán Hinds, Christopher Barrie, Noah Taylor (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Argument

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: Career thief Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) is about to mastermind a nearly impossible theft that will require his joining forces with a clever young accomplice (Edward Norton). The unlikely alliance, arranged by Nick's longtime friend and fence, Max (Marlon Brando), interrupts Nick's plan to retire from crime and settle down with his fiancée, Diane (Angela Bassett). Worse, it requires that Nick violate his most important rule: Always work alone. - Robert De Niro, Edward Norton, Angela Bassett, Marlon Brando, Gary Farmer (Thriller, Crime drama, Action)

programme.title: Citizen Bio
programme.desc: Exploring in depth the nascent biohacking movement and the unconventional scientists and researchers developing alternative medicines to prolong human life and eradicate incurable viruses and diseases. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: The Honey Trap: A True Story of Love, Lies and the FBI
programme.desc: The story of Denis Cuspert, aka Deso Dogg, and his journey from infamous German rapper to ISIS recruiter; exploring the circular relationship between propaganda, recruitment and the soft power of entertainment culture. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. - Mary J. Blige, Nat Wolff, David Zayas, Anika Noni Rose, Demetrius Grosse (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jamie Kennedy (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Chuck
programme.desc: He was the pride of Bayonne, N.J., a man who went 15 rounds in the ring with Muhammad Ali. But before all of that, Chuck Wepner was a liquor salesman and father with a modest prizefighting career whose life changed overnight when, in 1975, he was chosen to take on Ali in a highly publicized title match. It's the beginning of a wild ride through the exhilarating highs and humbling lows of sudden fame, but what happens when your 15 minutes in the spotlight are up? - Liev Schreiber, Elisabeth Moss, Naomi Watts, Ron Perlman, Jim Gaffigan (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system. - Courtney B. Vance, Keith David, Keesha Sharp, Rebecca Spence, Bentley Green (Crime drama)

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. - Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James, Jon Bernthal, Jon Hamm (Action, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war. - Dylan O'Brien, Michael Keaton, Sanaa Lathan, David Suchet, Navid Negahban (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. - Mary J. Blige, Nat Wolff, David Zayas, Anika Noni Rose, Demetrius Grosse (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Undisputed
programme.desc: An undefeated world-champion prizefighter, who is convicted of rape and sent to prison, must confront and fight the reigning prison boxing champion. - Wesley Snipes, Ving Rhames, Peter Falk, Michael Rooker, Jon Seda (Drama, Action)

programme.title: Seaside
programme.desc: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house. - Ariana DeBose, Matt Shingledecker, Steffanie Leigh, Sharon Washington, Jana Lee Hamblin (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: While traveling to California, Taylor and his wife, Amy, experience a vehicle malfunction on a remote highway. Amy Taylor accepts a ride from a truck driver to seek assistance while Jeff Taylor remains with the vehicle. When the couple fails to reunite at a designated location, Jeff Taylor begins a search for his wife despite a lack of assistance from local residents or law enforcement. - Kurt Russell, J.T. Walsh, Kathleen Quinlan, M.C. Gainey, Jack Noseworthy (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: The Comeback Trail
programme.desc: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. - Robert De Niro, Tommy Lee Jones, Morgan Freeman, Zach Braff, Emile Hirsch (Comedy)

programme.title: Before Dawn
programme.desc: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare, including a near-constant struggle to keep himself alive without leaving another man behind. - Levi Miller, Travis Jeffery, Myles Pollard, Tim Franklin, Jordan Dulieu (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: War Pony
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood. - Jojo Bapteise Whiting, LaDainian Crazy Thunder, Ashley Shelton, Robert Stover, Jesse Schmockel (Drama)

programme.title: Whitetail Fix - A Season's Worth of Work!
programme.desc: S14E8 - Jose puts in the work leading to heart-pounding experiences with giant whitetails that push his grit and determination to the limit. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Relentless Pursuit - Coyote 1
programme.desc: S19E9 - Join the Slock Master for an action-packed voyage into the past where primitive hunting is relived by the world's most recognized authority in spear and blowgun hunting. Laugh or cry, Tim Wells delivers every time. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Pigman: The Series - Axton's Army
programme.desc: S17E13 - Brian Pigman Quaca is a true-blue original—an unapologetic, high-energy host with a larger-than-life personality that has redefined outdoor television. With an unrelenting passion for the chase, Pigman takes on the world's toughest hunts, using any legal means necessary to put game on the ground. While his reputation was built on hardcore hog hunting, don't be mistaken—his skills extend far beyond wild pigs. (Hunting)

programme.title: MeatEater - Alaska Moose
programme.desc: S11E8 - Steve and Clay Newcomb travel to the wilds of interior Alaska for moose. (Outdoors, Hunting, Cooking)

programme.title: MeatEater - Alaska Black Bear
programme.desc: S12E1 - Steve takes Randall Williams and Clay Newcomb to his fish shack to hunt for black bears. (Outdoors, Hunting, Cooking)

programme.title: Jim Shockey's: The Professionals - Mako Sharks
programme.desc: S3E9 - Hunting for mako sharks in Orange County, Calif. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Crossroads With the Burtons - Bloodlines
programme.desc: S8E6 - Jeb takes his cousin Harrison into the field for a hunt neither will forget. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Roger Raglin Outdoors - The Big Surprise part 1
programme.desc: S24E9 - Roger and Josh Raglin take great free-range bucks in the hill country near Junction, Texas.

programme.title: Savage Outdoors - Coastal Brown Bear
programme.desc: S17E3 - Travel along with the Savage Outdoors crew as they travel North America on some of the most intense big game hunting adventures ever caught on film!

programme.title: Huntworx - Greg, Darek & Max - Missouri Bucks
programme.desc: S4E8 - Missouri delivers again with two hard-earned bowhunts in one packed episode as Greg and Darek close the distance on a mature buck, and Max Mongrello follows in a separate Missouri hunt.

programme.title: The Given Right - A Return to the Brooks Pt1
programme.desc: S12E7 - Tyler Weaver & Kenneth Lancaster return to the Brooks Range of Alaska, on a DIY caribou hunt.

programme.title: Backwoods Life - Buck Daze 2025: Kick-Off
programme.desc: S22E9 - Buck Daze 2025 kicks off with giant South Georgia bucks, camp stories, and the kind of high-energy hunting that defines deer season.

programme.title: Small Town Hunting - Cottonwood Part 5

programme.title: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man! - Part One
programme.desc: S1E1 - Chronicling the early experiences that shaped Brooks' comedic voice, from his childhood in Brooklyn, to his combat service in WWII, and the highs and lows of working in the Borscht Belt and the dawning era of television.

programme.title: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man!
programme.desc: S1E2 - Charting Brooks' rise to superstardom and the enduring impact of his work on audiences and future generations of comedic writers and performers.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. - Robert Pattinson, Naomi Ackie, Steven Yeun, Toni Collette, Mark Ruffalo (Science fiction, Comedy)

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve. - Jason Momoa, Jack Black, Sebastian Hansen, Emma Myers, Danielle Brooks (Family, Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy, Action)

programme.title: Tag
programme.desc: One month every year, five highly competitive friends hit the ground running for a no-holds-barred game of tag -- risking their necks, their jobs and their relationships to take one another down. This time, the game coincides with the wedding of the only undefeated player. What should be an easy target soon becomes an all-out war as he knows they're coming to get him. - Ed Helms, Jon Hamm, Jeremy Renner, Jake Johnson, Annabelle Wallis (Comedy)

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Animal pals Alex (Ben Stiller), Marty (Chris Rock), Melman (David Schwimmer) and Gloria (Jada Pinkett Smith) are still trying to make it back to New York's Central Park Zoo. They are forced to take a detour to Europe to find the penguins and chimps who broke the bank at a Monte Carlo casino. When French animal-control officer Capitaine Chantel DuBois (Frances McDormand) picks up their scent, Alex and company are forced to hide out in a traveling circus. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
programme.desc: The battle for NINJAGO City calls to action young Master Builder Lloyd, aka the Green Ninja, along with his friends, also secret ninja warriors. Led by Master Wu, as wise-cracking as he is wise, they must defeat the evil warlord Garmadon, who also happens to be Lloyd's dad. Pitting father against son, the epic showdown tests these fierce but undisciplined modern-day ninjas as they learn to check their egos and pull together to unleash the inner power of Spinjitzu. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: My Blind Brother
programme.desc: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. - Adam Scott, Nick Kroll, Jenny Slate, Charlie Hewson, Zoe Kazan (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Boys Go to Jupiter
programme.desc: Billy 5000, a teenage gig worker with a rise-and-grind mindset, aims to make $5,000. His quest is derailed by a gelatinous alien's appearance. (Animated, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Chris Fleming: Live at the Palace (Live)
programme.desc: Comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first stand-up special; a performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another, from Trader Joe's to Oreos, NPR and dog breeds; Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines and more. (Special, Comedy)

programme.title: Alex Edelman: Just for Us
programme.desc: Edelman shares his experience of covertly attending a meeting of white nationalists and coming face-to-face with the people behind the keyboards. (Special, Comedy, Standup)

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Mumble (Elijah Wood) the penguin, now called the Master of Tap, has an unusual problem: Erik, his son, is reluctant to dance. Erik runs away from home and encounters the Mighty Sven (Hank Azaria) -- a penguin that can fly. Poor Mumble can't compete with Erik's unusual new role model. But, when the world is shaken by powerful forces, Erik gets a chance to see his father's true colors as Mumble gathers all creatures great and small to set things right again. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Musical, Comedy)

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: It's summer, and Greg Heffley (Zachary Gordon) is looking forward to playing video games and spending time with his friends. However, Greg's dad (Steve Zahn) has other plans: He's decided that some father-son bonding time is in order. Desperate to prevent his dad from ruining summer vacation, Greg pretends he has a job at a ritzy country club. But Greg's plan backfires, leaving him in the middle of embarrassing mishaps and a camping trip gone wrong. - Zachary Gordon, Robert Capron, Devon Bostick, Rachael Harris, Steve Zahn (Children, Comedy)

programme.title: Paddington 2
programme.desc: Settled in with the Brown family, Paddington the bear is a popular member of the community who spreads joy and marmalade wherever he goes. One fine day, he spots a pop-up book in an antique shop, the perfect present for his beloved aunt's 100th birthday. When a thief steals the prized book, Paddington embarks on a quest to unmask the culprit before Aunt Lucy's big celebration. - Hugh Grant, Sally Hawkins, Hugh Bonneville, Brendan Gleeson, Julie Walters (Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animated)

programme.title: Life of the Party

Unfortunately, Deanna winds up at the same school as her less-than-thrilled daughter. Plunging headlong into the campus experience, the outspoken new student soon begins a journey of self-discovery while fully embracing all the fun, freedom and frat boys that she can handle. - Melissa McCarthy, Gillian Jacobs, Maya Rudolph, Julie Bowen, Matt Walsh (Comedy)

programme.title: House Party

Out of money, down on their luck and about to lose the roofs over their heads, they need a huge windfall to make their problems go away. They soon decide to host the party of the year at an exclusive mansion, which just happens to belong to none other than NBA superstar LeBron James. - Tosin Cole, Jacob Latimore, Karen Obilom, DC Young Fly, Andrew Santino (Comedy)

programme.title: Martin Lawrence: You So Crazy
programme.desc: Filmed at a sold-out Majestic Theater in Brooklyn, N.Y., comedian Martin Lawrence delivers his first full-length stand-up special. Harking back to Eddie Murphy, the leather-clad comic riffs on drugs, jail, his impoverished upbringing with his mother and his luck -- or lack thereof -- with women. He also speaks at length about racism and the Rodney King ruling and subsequent riots. Lawrence even offers his unique perspective on how to maintain a successful relationship. - Martin Lawrence (Comedy)

programme.desc: S1E4 - Nurserywoman Lyz is ready to practice what she preaches on her Fort Lauderdale, Fla., lawn; with dreams of hosting a butterfly rave, Joey and Al manage to burn some weeds not once, but twice. (Environment, House/garden)

programme.title: Kill Your Lawn - After Lawn Special
programme.desc: S2E4 - A boy surrounded by native plants becomes secretly lawn curious; when his parents find out, his punishment fits the crime, benefitting new neighbors with an invasive plant problem. (Environment, House/garden, Entertainment)

programme.title: Kill Your Lawn - Tiny Cups & Big Trees
programme.desc: S1E2 - With the help of a legendary naturalist, Joey sets aside fears of an outstanding arrest warrant in Miami to help lawn killer Charlie fight a dated city regulation against two mighty cypress species. (Environment, House/garden)

programme.title: Kill Your Lawn - Anti-Lawn Gospel
programme.desc: S2E2 - Lawn killing missionaries convert a neuroscientist couple, inspiring them to recontour their front yard by removing invasive species and planting a color palette of native flowering plants. (Environment, House/garden, Entertainment)

programme.title: Rock the Park - Best of Rivers and Waterfalls

programme.title: Rock the Park - New River Gorge National River
programme.desc: S4E1 - Jack and Colton explore one of the oldest rivers in North America, one of the biggest bridges in the country, and New River. (Nature, Travel)

programme.title: BlueMarvel - Acadia Evening Drive

programme.title: Destruction Decoded - Mega Floods; Tsunamis

programme.title: Our Living Oceans - Ocean Optimism

programme.title: Our Living Oceans - Corals and Marine Protected Areas

programme.title: The Climate Restorers - Methane

Will, who lives in a strict religious environment, is only too happy to oblige his new friend. - Bill Milner, Will Poulter, Jules Sitruk, Jessica Stevenson, Neil Dudgeon (Comedy)

When he accidentally winds up in a frontier town called Dirt, he takes the first step on a transformational journey as the town's new sheriff. Though at first Rango only role-plays, a series of thrilling situations and outrageous encounters forces him to become a real hero. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Drama, Thriller)
